errors.auth: Signed out of BLUETTI. Open the device settings and choose Repair to sign in again.
errors.offline: The power station is offline in the BLUETTI cloud. Check its Wi-Fi connection.
errors.not_supported: This power station does not support __output__.
errors.ble_command: The power station is offline in the BLUETTI cloud and could not be reached over Bluetooth: __message__
errors.ble_refused: The power station did not apply the command.
errors.cloud_only: The BLUETTI cloud is not answering, and __output__ can only be switched through the cloud: __message__

ble.not_found: Power station not found over Bluetooth. Is Homey within range?

timeline.offline: __name__ lost its connection to the BLUETTI cloud (no Wi-Fi or internet on the power station). When you are near the power station, reconnect it to Wi-Fi in the BLUETTI app (this can take a few minutes) and then close the app. If that does not help, switch the power station off and on (this also switches off its AC output).
timeline.offline_ble: __name__ lost its connection to the BLUETTI cloud (no Wi-Fi or internet on the power station). Homey keeps reading and switching it over Bluetooth while it is in range. When you are near the power station, reconnect it to Wi-Fi in the BLUETTI app (this can take a few minutes) and then close the app. If that does not help, switch the power station off and on (this also switches off its AC output).
timeline.signed_out: BLUETTI: signed out. Open __name__ and choose Repair to sign in again.
